name: orca-inp
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics and autocompletion for ORCA quantum chemistry input files (.inp)

commands.title: Create Basis-Set Variants of This Input

orcaInp.diagnostics.enable.description: Enable live syntax/structure diagnostics for .inp files.

orcaInp.diagnostics.unknownKeywordSeveri.description: Severity used when a simple-input (!) keyword is not recognized.

orcaInp.diagnostics.semantic.description: Chemistry-aware checks: charge/multiplicity parity, atom order, conflicting runtypes, OptTS without Hessian, %tddft without NRoots, several basis sets.

orcaInp.diagnostics.memoryCheck.description: Warn when %maxcore x nprocs exceeds 75 % of this machine's memory. Off by default, since inputs are often written locally but run on a cluster.

orcaInp.referenceAtomOrder.markdownDescription: Expected element order of the coordinate block, e.g. `C O O H H`. Leave empty to disable. Downstream scripts (Wigner sampling, MD, ML descriptors) usually rely on a fixed atom order. Best set per workspace.

orcaInp.ts.autoPrompt.description: Offer to displace the geometry when an optimization finishes at a saddle point (and to create an IRC input after a clean TS search).

orcaInp.ts.maxDisplacement.description: Displacement along the imaginary mode, in Å, of the atom that moves most.

orcaInp.ts.imagThreshold.description: Frequencies below this value (cm⁻¹) count as imaginary modes; between it and 0 they are reported as likely numerical noise.

orcaInp.ts.useMoread.description: Start the displaced job from the previous orbitals (adds MORead + %moinp "job.gbw").

orcaInp.wigner.temperature.description: Temperature (K) used in the Wigner readiness report.

orcaInp.wigner.softModeThreshold.description: Modes below this wavenumber (cm⁻¹) are flagged as soft / possibly anharmonic in the Wigner report.

orcaInp.variants.basisSets.description: Basis sets offered by 'Create Basis-Set Variants'.

orcaInp.watchedCoordinates.markdownDescription: Internal coordinates for 'Compare Final Geometries', as `label: i-j[-k[-l]]` with 1-based atom indices, e.g. `O-O: 2-3`, `C-O-O: 1-2-3`. A `.orca-watch.json` array in the folder takes precedence.

orcaInp.pyneapples.pattern.description: Glob (relative to the chosen folder) selecting the per-geometry outputs for the PyNEAppLES export.

orcaInp.spectrum.singleGeometryBandwidth.description: Gaussian width (eV) used when previewing the spectrum of a single geometry.

orcaInp.nea.scriptsDir.description: Path to the uv-vis scripts/ directory (from_geometry.py, ...). Empty = search the workspace.

orcaInp.runs.exclude.description: Glob of folders ignored when batch commands look for .out files.

orcaInp.studio.calcGlobs.description: Globs (relative to each workspace folder) of calculation results the Studio's Calculations tab scans: PySCF geom_NNNN/result.json sets, ORCA .out files, and other .json files with a boolean "converged" key. Paths matching orcaInp.runs.exclude are skipped.

orcaInp.studio.geometryGlobs.description: Globs of multi-XYZ trajectories and ensembles listed in the Geometries tab of Orbital Studio.

orcaInp.studio.geometryExcludeGlobs.description: Globs left out of the Geometries library (per-geometry calculation folders by default), in addition to orcaInp.runs.exclude.

orcaInp.studio.datGlobs.description: Globs of MD column files (energies.dat, temper.dat, est_energy.dat, ...) listed in the Trajectory (.dat) view of the Geometries tab.

orcaInp.studio.datExcludeGlobs.description: Globs left out of the Trajectory (.dat) file list (spectra and per-geometry folders by default), in addition to orcaInp.runs.exclude.

orcaInp.studio.processPattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) matched against "<process name> <command line>" to pick the calculation processes the Studio's Runs tab lists: by default ORCA (orca, orca_*), xtb, crest, Gaussian, CP2K, ABIN, Psi4, mpirun/srun, and Python running PySCF or run_*/ml_worker/from_geometry/from_ensemble/compare_ensembles scripts.

orcaInp.studio.logGlobs.description: Globs of log files the Studio's Runs tab lists (the 50 most recently modified are shown).

orcaInp.studio.logExcludeGlobs.description: Globs left out of the Runs tab's log list, in addition to orcaInp.runs.exclude (default: the per-geometry directories of ensembles).

orcaInp.studio.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter that runs the Orbital Studio ML worker (`python/ml_worker.py`). Needs numpy, scipy, pandas, scikit-learn, joblib and threadpoolctl; dscribe + ase for the CM/SOAP/MBTR representations, xgboost for XGBoost. Use the full path of a venv/conda interpreter if `python` on PATH is not the right one.

orcaInp.studio.ml.maxJobs.description: Upper limit for the number of cores (n_jobs) an ML run may use.

enumDescriptions: tectonic: self-contained engine that downloads packages on demand
latexmk -pdf: runs pdflatex/bibtex as often as needed (TeX Live, MiKTeX)
orcaInp.studio.latexEngine.description: LaTeX engine the Report tab compiles with.

orcaInp.studio.latexPath.description: Full path of the LaTeX engine executable; empty = the engine name on PATH.

orcaInp.studio.compileTimeoutSec.description: Seconds after which a LaTeX compilation is stopped.

orcaInp.studio.reportFile.description: The .tex the Report tab opens (relative to the first workspace folder). Empty = ask, then remember the last one opened.

orcaInp.studio.figureGlobs.description: Images in the workspace the Report tab offers to import into the report's figures folder.

orcaInp.studio.spectraGlobs.description: Globs (relative to each workspace folder) of NEA spectrum files listed in the Studio Spectra tab: columns x, total[, CI low, CI high, S1..SN] as written by PyNEAppLES.

orcaInp.studio.experimentGlobs.description: Globs of experimental two-column spectra (x, y; whitespace, tab, comma or semicolon separated), drawn dashed in the Studio Spectra tab. Any file can also be added with "Add files…" and toggled to experiment.

orcaInp.studio.spectrumNamePattern.description: Regular expression applied to spectrum file stems in the Studio Spectra tab; every named group becomes a filterable column of the library (e.g. wigner-augccpVDZ_adc3-augccpVDZ_n1000 → sampling, geometry, method, basis, n).
